name: SQUID migration self-sale uses manipulable minimum output
summary: SquidTokenSwap gave SQUID V2 one-for-one for V1 to anyone and let anyone call sellSwappedTokens, whose minimum output came from the same live Pancake reserves the sale traded through. Attackers bought cheap V1, swapped it for V2 at par, triggered the contract's V1-to-V2 sales to lift V2, and dumped the V2 for WBNB.
notes: Reset: deployment. enableSwap and blacklist calls are trading gates, not resets.

Campaign: the five later transactions that combined swapTokens and sellSwappedTokens from a contract (three actors, April 8 and 14); plain user migrations are excluded. Loss is the net WBNB depletion of the SQUID V1 and V2 pools per transaction, including the flash fees paid out of them.
